meta.description:
🙂 Welcome to Emoji Simulator! 🙂

Make emoji simulations and stuff!

Here's some examples to spark your imagination: (copy-paste links below)

a Letter Civilization (By Rylid-Umil)
https://rylid-umil.github.io/LETTERCIVILIZATION/?s=letter

🔥 Forest Fires (this one you're seeing!)
(← CLICK on the grid to create a fire)

💀 Epidemics
https://rylid-umil.github.io/LETTERCIVILIZATION/?s=sick

🌸 Conway's Game of Life
https://rylid-umil.github.io/LETTERCIVILIZATION/?s=conway

🔴 B-Z Chemical Spirals
https://rylid-umil.github.io/LETTERCIVILIZATION/?s=bz

🐹 Schelling's Segregation Model
https://rylid-umil.github.io/LETTERCIVILIZATION/?s=schelling

🦊 Predator-Prey Model
https://rylid-umil.github.io/LETTERCIVILIZATION/?s=prey

🏖 Procedurally Generated Beaches
https://rylid-umil.github.io/LETTERCIVILIZATION/?s=beach

😐 [Blank Sim] (to make your own)
https://rylid-umil.github.io/LETTERCIVILIZATION/?s=blank

You can edit the text in ANY of these textboxes, including this one. Normal text is allowed, and so is putting more than one character in a textbox. Change the rules & emoji below to make new sims. Finally, you can SAVE and SHARE your sim. You can export it as a JSON file, but you HAVE to also save it as a link, because there is no import button and I can't add one... 😭

Don't fall for the same mistake as me, guys!

Have fun! 🎉
